Question
========
Which of the following statements is correct with respect to H0 and Ha? μ stands for population mean. Check the statement(s) that is/are true; at least one statement is true.

Answerlist
----------
* H0: μ1 = μ2
* Ha: μ1 ≠ μ2
* H0: μ1 ≠ μ2
* Ha: μ1 > μ2

Solution
========
H0: mu1 = mu2. The null hypothesis is that there is no difference. The means of both groups in the population will in that case be equal to each other.

Ha: mu1 != mu2. The alternative hypothesis states that the means do differ. A two-tailed test is performed, because you have no expectation about the direction of a possible difference between the means.

DSUJ §2.10.2, p. 84; §2.10.6, p. 93. discoverjasp: [Task 9.5](https://discoverjasp.com/pages/smart_alex.html#task-9.5).

Answerlist
----------
* True.
* True.
* False.
* False.
